### Confrontational Christlikeness
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/confrontational-christlikeness
Passage: 1 Kings 22:14
Points:
- Believers often default to polite agreeableness, avoiding any hard truths that might displease others.
- Micaiah resisted intense pressure from the royal messenger to conform to the popular consensus.
- He committed himself to speaking only what the Lord commanded, regardless of personal cost.
- Being disliked by the world can be an indicator of faithful allegiance to God rather than unfaithfulness.
- True Christlikeness requires the courage to speak God's truth even when it provokes hostility.
